The submitted answer is "nitēhuetzā"; the verified answer is "nihuetzi".

Sentence 17, *tēhuetzītia in zihuātl* ("the woman makes somebody fall"), breaks down as tē- (indefinite object "somebody") + huetzi ("fall") + -tia (causative). The intransitive verb "fall" is therefore *huetzi*. The first-person subject prefix is ni- (*niki* "I drink"), and an intransitive verb takes no object prefix (*titzāhtzi* "you shout"). So "I fall" is ni- + huetzi = *nihuetzi*.

The submitted form adds the object prefix tē- ("somebody"), which does not belong in an intransitive "I fall". It also changes the ending to -ā, which is not the bare stem seen in the data.
